name: Punch | ROVE Classics | 1g
description:
Dive into the bold, sweet, and fruity flavors of this lively sativa. Bursting with tropical vibes, it’s here to add a spark to your day and set the tone for good times ahead. Whether you're starting a new project or enjoying time with friends, this punchy blend is your ultimate mood booster.
